prompts.modern: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original production background plate for a refined interactive Chinese West Lake handscroll website. Create an exquisitely detailed continuous panoramic painting of TODAY'S West Lake in Hangzhou, China. Very wide 3:1 landscape composition, highest detail. Fine precise architectural ink contours and restrained mineral watercolor on warm pale silk ivory (#e8ddc4). Sophisticated Chinese landscape handscroll, fine-line gongbi landscape with pale jade greens, warm grey tiled roofs, soft sage mountains and softly reflected pale lake water. Not vector, not cartoon, not photorealistic. Continuous picturesque lakeshore from left to right: low gently arched Broken Bridge connected to willow-lined Bai Causeway; Gushan waterside pavilion and traditional lakeside buildings; long willow-lined Su Causeway with elegant little stone bridges; pink lotus beds and curved pavilion; three small stone pagodas in the open lake; elegant tiered Leifeng Pagoda on a forested hill in the right distance. Include small contemporary walkers, a few bicycles, refined contemporary lakefront cafes, a small modern electric sightseeing boat: modern Hangzhou living harmoniously with Chinese garden architecture. A very subtle modern Hangzhou skyline is far in the right background behind atmospheric haze, not tall dense towers by the protected lake. Composition: distant hazy mountain silhouettes and pale sky in upper 30%, finely detailed scenic shoreline and bridges in middle 40%, beautifully open lake water and reflections in lower 30%. The picture reads as a single uninterrupted, spatially rich cultural landscape, not a grid or collage. Riverbank paths clearly visible. Soft morning light, tranquil but inhabited, authentic Jiangnan detail. The extreme upper edge fades into blank warm ivory paper. No text, no labels, no seals, no border, no UI, no watermark. Produce the panorama only.
prompts.song: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: original finely detailed panorama background for a horizontally scrollable interactive Song-dynasty West Lake handscroll. Wide 3:1 panorama, highest possible detailed resolution. Authentic refined Chinese gongbi architectural ink and very pale mineral watercolor on light warm ivory silk (#e8ddc4), fine warm-grey ink linework, muted sage willow foliage, subdued ochre timber, carefully hatched tiled roofs, pale jade lake, distant blue-green misty mountains. Warm dry elegant antique aesthetic like a meticulously crafted museum handscroll, NOT cartoon vector, NOT 3D. Side elevation camera with slight elevated roof depth, consistent architectural scale across frame. Layered mountains, distant pagoda, quiet sky occupy top 35%. Near shoreline occupies middle 35%. Clear mostly horizontal walkable stone causeway path at precisely y=70% across the ENTIRE picture, paved quay top y=73%, open lake below y=77%, foreground water bottom 23%. From left to right: willow grove and waterside pavilion at x=10%, low Song timber tea houses with open windows and cups/stools at x=25%, a modest low gently arched stone bridge over a narrow tributary at x=48% (bridge feet at y=70%, apex y=62%, width 12% of entire picture), open tea stalls, modest traditional market shops, fabric awnings, baskets and ceramic jars at x=63%, small covered timber jetty with stairs to water at x=79%, quieter gardens and willows at x=92%. Distant historic Leifeng tower on hill at x=85%, small islands and stone lanterns suggested across the lake. Dense exquisite architectural detail but breathing room, contemplative Jiangnan West Lake landscape blended with Song street life. No humans, no animals, NO boats anywhere because all figures and boats will be animated separately. Clear readable ground for placing people later. All shop signs blank. No text, no lettering, no seals, no collage panels, no framing, no watermark, no UI. A continuous painting not a real geographic map.
prompts.people: Use case: historical-scene. Production character sprite atlas for a refined Song dynasty Chinese handscroll game. Exactly SIX separate full-body adult historical characters on TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, arranged strictly three columns by two rows, equal cells, full body including shoes, every figure centered in own cell with plenty of transparent margins. Canvas landscape 3:2. Top row: 1) young male scholar in pale jade robe and dark Song headpiece, side profile facing right, relaxed walking stance; 2) woman in muted dusty rose Song dynasty long dress, side profile facing right, carrying folded fan; 3) middle-aged tea seller in ochre short tunic and dark trousers, three-quarter view standing with hands in front. Bottom row: 4) older fisherman in faded indigo jacket, straw hat and grey trousers, side profile facing right; 5) young woman in pale lavender long Song robe carrying basket, facing right; 6) middle aged gentleman in subdued grey-green long robe and cloth hat, facing right. Fine detailed warm grey ink outlines and restrained traditional watercolor, sophisticated tiny figures from a historic Chinese painting, natural human proportions, intricate robe folds, subtle face details. Avoid thick black outlines, avoid modern cartoon, avoid vector shapes, avoid 3D. No shadows, no ground, no paper background, no props outside hands, no text, no borders, no labels, no watermark. Transparent outside figures.
